messages:
Samir Kaur: Customer reports that after we promoted alder-7b-v2 -> alder-7b-v2.1 they now get invalid JSON from structured output, intermittent nulls in nested fields. Example payload attached.

Priya Nair: Can you paste the sample request + response? Customer reported it started right after the weight rotation at 09:12 UTC?

Samir Kaur: Pasting minimal repro. Request:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/complete \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \
 -d '{"model":"alder-7b-v2.1","prompt":"Generate JSON list of products",""structured_output":true}'
```
Response (streamed chunks):
```
{"products":[{"id":1,"name":"widget"},
{"id":2,"name":"gadget"},
null
]}
```
Parser fails because of the lone `null` between objects.

Javier Mendez: Huh, null inserted between items. Does customer use streaming parser that stitches chunks? Could be chunk boundary splitting a token causing `null` token emitted.

Samir Kaur: They do stitch. They said it only happens ~10% of requests, always after the rollout window. We've asked for full raw chunks and they sent them — attaching decoded chunks:
```
chunk1: {"products":[{"id":1,"name":"widget"},
chunk2: {"id":2,"name":"gadget"},
chunk3: null
chunk4: ]}
```

Claire O'Neill: This looks like the model started emitting an extra `null` token as its own chunk. Could be from a prompt-contiguous generation instruction change or tokenizer remap. Eng-ML: any recent tokenization changes in v2.1?

eng-bot: Notified #eng-ml and #eng-runtime with link to thread.

Priya Nair: Immediate customer workaround: pin to alder-7b-v2 (pre-promotion) or set `stream: false` / use strict JSON mode with post-aggregation validation. Also recommend adding a small filter to drop sole `null` tokens between array items while we investigate.

Javier Mendez: Repro steps for eng-runtime:
1) promote alder-7b-v2 -> v2.1 on a canary region
2) hit structured_output streaming endpoint with small batched requests
3) collect raw chunks and token-level traces

Claire O'Neill: I can take token traces from canary. Samir, share customer request id and approximate timestamps.

Samir Kaur: Request id 01F8XY-3Z, timestamps 2026-03-11T09:12:45Z -> 09:12:46Z. Customer is experiencing user-visible parse error. They want ETA to rollback.

Priya Nair: We should offer rollback if root cause isolatable within 24h. Eng teams: please mark priority P1 for structured-output correctness regression. Tagging @Javier @Claire.

eng-bot: Issue created #INC-2026-489: 'alder-7b-v2.1 streaming null-token insertion causing structured_output parse failures'. Assigned: eng-ml (Javier), eng-runtime (Claire).

Javier Mendez: Early hypothesis: quantization instruction in v2.1 changed tokenization of the separator causing model to emit explicit null filler when a generation stop token is misaligned. I'll run tokenization diffs.

Claire O'Neill: I'll repro on canary and attach coredump/rt-trace. Thanks Samir, Samir: please cc customer success with rollback option.

Samir Kaur: Will do, pinged them and offered pin or rollback. Customer ok with temporary pin. Closing loop once we have root cause.

Priya Nair: Thanks all. Keep updates in this thread. :pray:
